rules.claim: The #0c fast-follow deletes the legacy TampDiagnostics dual emission path; adding it as a hand-synced emitter is forbidden.
The build script stays plain C# referencing Tamp.Core; no manifest/DSL format.
A skipped tracking test ('beacon still on legacy emitter — remove after #0c') guards the temporary double-emit window.
Event schema is governed additive-only with a schemaVersion / single schema registry.
Every action, event, and artifact carries a worker id — attributable by construction.
Least privilege: side-effectful/publish/deploy/secret-reveal targets gated behind explicit capability tiers.
Event payloads carry access-requested, never the secret value (ADR-0005 reinforcement).
inputsHash is emitted in the typed result but is observability-only with no execution effect (cache-aware skipping deferred).
Slice-running --only/--from fails closed: error if a required declared upstream artifact is absent.
The MCP control surface exposes list_targets, describe_target, plan --json, run_target, get_result, get_log with a read/drive split.
